Advisory & Value Realization

Decide what matters.

Guidance on architecture, security, cross-workstream processes, governance, scaling and value realization.

Typical work: architecture reviews, impact assessments, roadmaps and success measures.

  • Value realization & decision supportCompare options and cross-workstream tradeoffs; prioritize changes against business value and risk.
  • Enterprise architecture & readinessAssess architecture, security dependencies and cross-workstream impacts; plan for readiness and future scale.
  • Governance & operating modelsDefine decision rights and support ownership across workstreams, including change, release and escalation paths.
  • Business process & platform healthTrace end-to-end processes to find cross-workstream bottlenecks, control gaps and recurring defects.
See advisory services

Configuration & Engineering

Make it work better.

Hands-on Workday configuration, security and integrations, designed for end-to-end processes and downstream impacts.

Typical work: tested changes, access controls, integration fixes and release readiness.

  • Configuration & securityConfigure Workday workflows, security roles, approvals and controls with downstream impacts in view.
  • Integrations & automationConnect Workday with procurement, expense, benefits, CRM, ticketing and other systems while protecting end-to-end flows.
  • Releases & stabilizationAssess release effects across workstreams, security and integrations; support testing and stabilization.
  • Reporting & dataImprove reports, data quality and reconciliation across dependent workstreams and systems.

Organizational Change & M&A

Mergers, affiliations, restructuring, and institutional growth introduce complexity across organizational structures, security, configurations, and connected enterprise systems.

Kaiora helps institutions assess technology impacts, scale security and configuration models, align cross-functional processes, and support technical integration and transition readiness.

Possible Starting Deliverables

  • Enterprise architecture and dependency assessment
  • Security and configuration scalability assessment
  • Integration impact and transition roadmap

Focus: Enterprise technology integration, scalability, and operational continuity—not financial or legal transaction advice.

Your Challenges. Our Expertise.

Whether preparing for transformation, improving an existing Workday environment, or navigating organizational change, Kaiora combines strategic guidance with hands-on execution.

Gerta Gjata

Founder & Principal Consultant

Gerta is an enterprise technology leader with over 20 years of experience helping organizations improve how they operate, grow and adapt to change. Her early career built a strong foundation in business operations, process improvement and data analytics. Over the past decade, her work has focused on ERP strategy, enterprise applications and digital transformation.

Her career spans higher education, healthcare and consulting, including Northeastern University, WVU Medicine, Worcester Polytechnic Institute (WPI), Clark University and PwC. She has supported organizations through growth, mergers and acquisitions, complex implementations and operational change, while leading teams, developing governance frameworks and improving value from technology investments.

Gerta brings strategic and hands-on experience across Workday HCM, Finance, Supply Chain and Student, with particular depth in Workday security, enterprise architecture, platform governance and operational optimization. She enjoys working across functions to understand challenges and build practical solutions that make work easier and more effective.
